description: This file manages the floating point unit (FPU) context, including saving, restoring, and lazy context switching for ARM64 architecture within Zephyr RTOS. It includes functions for FPU trap handling, context switching, and debug support.

methods.name: DBG
methods.description: Debug function for FPU-related tracing, outputs current CPU, exception depth, thread name, and message.

methods.name: arch_flush_local_fpu
methods.description: Flushes the local FPU context and disables FPU access for the current CPU.

methods.name: flush_owned_fpu
methods.description: Sends an IPI to flush FPU context on other CPUs where the thread owns the FPU.

methods.name: z_arm64_fpu_enter_exc
methods.description: Handles entering an exception by denying FPU access.

methods.name: simulate_str_q_insn
methods.description: Simulates certain FPU store instructions during exceptions to avoid traps.

methods.name: z_arm64_fpu_trap
methods.description: Handles FPU trap, saving/restoring FPU context, and managing ownership.

methods.name: z_arm64_fpu_exit_exc
methods.description: Updates FPU access permissions on exception exit.

methods.name: z_arm64_fpu_thread_context_switch
methods.description: Updates FPU access permissions during thread context switch.

methods.name: arch_float_disable
methods.description: Disables FPU for a thread, flushing context if necessary.

methods.name: arch_float_enable
methods.description: Enables FPU for a thread (currently always returns 0).
